title: World population by country
subtitle: 1960 to 2024 population counts
hook: Tracking annual population counts from 1960 to 2024 reveals shifts in global leadership among nations.
setup: During this period, countries such as China and India held the highest population counts.

sequence.text: In 1960, China led with a population of 667070000.
In 2021, India led with a population of 1414203896.
In 2022, India led with a population of 1425423212.
In 2023, India led with a population of 1438069596.

highlights.headline: China leads in 1960
highlights.detail: China recorded a population of 667070000 in 1960.

highlights.headline: India leads in 2023
highlights.detail: India recorded a population of 1438069596 in 2023.

ending: Global population leadership shifted from China to India over the recorded decades.
